f.title: Report fatal or life-threatening UK SUSARs to the licensing authority within 7 days
f.statement: The sponsor must ensure that all relevant information about a suspected unexpected serious adverse reaction (SUSAR) that occurs during the course of a clinical trial in the United Kingdom and is fatal or life-threatening is reported to the licensing authority as soon as possible, and in any event no later than 7 days after the sponsor was first aware of the reaction.
f.clause: Part 5 Pharmacovigilance, regulation 33(1) Notification of suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions
f.legal_basis: Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004, reg. 33(1)
f.applicability: Fatal or life-threatening SUSARs occurring during the course of a clinical trial in the United Kingdom
f.exceptions: Does not apply to SUSARs specified in the protocol as not requiring immediate reporting (reg. 33(4A)); those are reported as the protocol specifies (reg. 33(4B)).

f.title: Send additional relevant information on a fatal or life-threatening SUSAR within 8 days of the initial report
f.statement: Within 8 days of a report of a fatal or life-threatening SUSAR made under regulation 33(1), the sponsor must ensure that any additional relevant information is sent to the licensing authority.
f.legal_basis: Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004, reg. 33(2)
f.applicability: Follow-up of fatal or life-threatening SUSARs reported under regulation 33(1)

f.title: Report other UK SUSARs to the licensing authority within 15 days
f.statement: The sponsor must ensure that a SUSAR occurring during the course of a clinical trial in the United Kingdom, other than a fatal or life-threatening one reported under regulation 33(1), is reported to the licensing authority as soon as possible, and in any event no later than 15 days after the sponsor is first aware of the reaction.
f.legal_basis: Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004, reg. 33(3)
f.applicability: SUSARs occurring during the course of a clinical trial in the United Kingdom that are not fatal or life-threatening
f.exceptions: Does not apply to SUSARs specified in the protocol as not requiring immediate reporting (reg. 33(4A)).

f.title: Expedited SUSAR timelines do not apply to SUSARs the protocol specifies as not requiring immediate reporting
f.statement: The 7-day, 8-day follow-up and 15-day SUSAR reporting duties in regulation 33(1) to (3) do not apply to SUSARs specified in the trial protocol as not requiring immediate reporting.
f.legal_basis: Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004, reg. 33(4A)
f.applicability: SUSARs specified in the protocol as not requiring immediate reporting

f.title: Report protocol-exempted SUSARs to the licensing authority as and when the protocol specifies
f.statement: The sponsor must report SUSARs that the protocol specifies as not requiring immediate reporting to the licensing authority in accordance with the reporting requirements, including the time periods for such reporting, specified in the protocol.
